title: FAI Accelerator Manifest
description: The cross-cloud Solution Accelerator manifest used by the FAI Orchard. Carries identity, descriptive, classification, maturity, licensing, cost, deployment, eval, FAI-compatibility, pollination, and provenance metadata for one accelerator (harvested, cultivated, or first-party). Schema is CC0-1.0; adopt freely. See https://github.com/Pavleen-Singh/frootai/tree/main/orchard for the registry, validators, and contribution flow. See planning/fai-orchard-masterplan.md §S and §G for the conceptual model; planning/fai-orchard-manifest-schema.md for the full spec.
$comment: License: CC0-1.0 (Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal — public domain dedication). https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode. SPDX-License-Identifier: CC0-1.0. Authored by FrootAI 2026-05-24 as part of Phase [A0.2] of the FAI Orchard master plan. Forward-compat: origin + composed_from fields baked in at v1.0.0 to support FAI Greenhouse (Phase [A11]) without a future major version bump.

$schema.description: Optional URL of the schema this document validates against. Conventionally https://frootai.dev/schemas/fai-accelerator.v1.json.

schema_version.description: Strict semver of this schema (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). v1.0.0 is the initial release.

id.description: Canonical identifier: <owner>__<repo>, lowercase, double-underscore separator. Example: azure-samples__azure-search-openai-demo.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Often the repo name with spaces and proper case.

slug.description: URL-safe slug used in /orchard/<variety>/<slug>. Derived from repo name.

variety.description: Cloud variety. hybrid = spans multiple clouds.

owner.description: GitHub org or user. Case preserved from GitHub (e.g., Azure-Samples).

owner_type.description: Owner classification. first_party = cloud vendor org (Azure-Samples, GoogleCloudPlatform, aws-samples). community = independent OSS. partner = vendor partner. frootai = FrootAI itself.

repo_url.description: Canonical GitHub URL. No trailing slash. No .git suffix.

default_branch.description: Default branch name (typically main or master).

homepage.description: Optional separate website URL declared by the repo.

tagline.description: One-line elevator pitch. ≤140 chars. Shown in grid cards.

description.description: 1-3 paragraphs. May be a README excerpt or LLM-polished summary.

categories.description: Controlled vocabulary, 1:1 mapping with Solution Play categories. See planning/fai-orchard-manifest-schema.md §3.

tech.description: Free-form tech stack tags. Examples: 'Azure OpenAI', 'Bicep', 'LangChain'.

languages.description: Top GitHub languages by bytes (from GitHub API /repos/{owner}/{repo}/languages).

tags.description: Free-form lowercase tags. Used for search, not for filtering UI.

froot_layer.description: FROOT layer classification: F=Foundations, R=Reasoning, O1=Orchestration, O2=Operations, T=Transformation. See planning/fai-orchard-manifest-schema.md §4.

froot_layer_reason.description: Short justification from the classifier prompt.

ripeness.description: Maturity tier. Computed deterministically by enrich.js — never LLM-judged. See §5.

ripeness_signals.description: Raw signals used to compute ripeness. Recorded for auditability.

season_reason.description: Short justification (which signal moved it into this season).

first_seen.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When this fruit was first harvested by the Orchard.

last_commit.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Date of most recent commit on default_branch.

last_release.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Date of most recent GitHub release, or null if none.

license.description: SPDX license identifier (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-3-Clause, CC0-1.0, etc.) OR the literal string 'Unknown'.

license_url.description: URL to the LICENSE file in the repo.

trust_badges.description: Controlled vocab of trust badges. See §6.

code_of_conduct.description: True if CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md exists at repo root.

security_md.description: True if SECURITY.md exists at repo root.

cost_band.description: Human-readable cost band shown in the UI. Example: '$200-800/mo'.

cost_estimate.description: Structured cost estimate. low <= high enforced via allOf below.

azd_template.description: True if azure.yaml exists at repo root (Azure Developer CLI template).

fai_compatible.description: How well this accelerator already speaks FAI primitives.

pollinates.description: Cross-links from this Accelerator to FrootAI Solution Plays. Many-to-many.

origin.description: How this accelerator entered the Orchard. harvested = crawled from external GitHub (Phase A1+A2). cultivated = composed by FrootAI's Builder agent from verified modules (Phase A11). first_party = hand-authored by FrootAI (rare; legacy 101 Plays' infra). See planning/fai-orchard-masterplan.md §G.

module_path.description: Canonical module path. Example: avm/ptn/ai-ml/ai-foundry OR Azure/openai/azurerm.

upstream_url.description: Direct URL to the pinned module source.

integrity_sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex sha256 of the module bytes at pin time.

composed_from.description: Provenance chain for cultivated accelerators. REQUIRED when origin == 'cultivated'. See planning/fai-orchard-manifest-schema.md §13.2.

composition_method.description: Identifier of the cultivation method. Example: frootai-greenhouse/v1.0.

composed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When the Builder agent composed this accelerator.

composed_by_agent.description: Identifier of the Builder agent version. Example: builder-v3.2.

gold_iac.description: True if the IaC was hand-authored instead of composed from verified modules. Doctrine line 9 says this MUST be false for cultivated accelerators unless gold_iac_reason is supplied (escape valve tracked in CI).

gold_iac_reason.description: REQUIRED when gold_iac is true. Free-form justification for the doctrine exception.

harvested_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. When the pipeline harvested or composed this fruit.

first_party.description: True if this repo is owned by FrootAI.

step.description: Pipeline step name. Examples: froot_layer_classification, cost_estimation, tagline_polish, pollination_suggest.

enriched_by.description: Stamp per LLM-touched field. Doctrine line 3: NO SILENT ENRICHMENT.

items.description: Path to override file merged in. Example: overrides/azure-samples__azure-search-openai-demo.json.

provenance.description: Required on every fruit. The complete audit trail.

search_keywords.description: Lowercase keywords for full-text search. Auto-derived from tagline + categories + tech.

readme_excerpt.description: First ~500 chars of the README for full-text search.

semantic_embedding_id.description: Pointer into the semantic-search vector store. Populated by Phase A3 search indexer.

allOf.$comment: Validator rule §13.3.1: origin=cultivated implies composed_from required and non-empty.
Validator rule §13.3.2: gold_iac=true requires gold_iac_reason (doctrine line 9 escape valve).
Cultivated fruits MUST use source=frootai-greenhouse in provenance.
Harvested fruits MUST use source=github-api in provenance.
